correctness.rationale: The assigned matrix boundary rows and interior five-point stencil reconstruct as M=12D+D²+e1*r^T+en*(Jr)^T. For d_j=u_j-u_(j-1), the two left defect Hermitian forms are (-2|d1|²+3Re d1*d2-Re d1*d3) and (-3|d1|²+6Re d1*d2-4Re d1*d3+Re d1*d4). Rank-two least eigenvalues give losses tau_BH=1+sqrt(14)/2 and tau_OS=(3+sqrt(62))/2; boundary edge sets overlap at most twice, giving 12-2tau=beta. Dirichlet eigenvalue lambda_n>0 then yields the stated accretivity bound for any complex u, and standard energy/resolvent identities prove the contraction estimates. The positive (2,4) off-diagonal of M yields a negative (2,4) heat-kernel entry to first order; mismatched (1,3) and (3,1) prevent positive diagonal symmetrization. Checked actual verify.py quadratic-form construction and independently enumerated n=5..9 integer vectors. No optimal beta claim or higher-order generality.
